technical.lead: Unsloth Studio's June build turns local fine-tuning into an MCP agent workbench
technical.body: Unsloth shipped a fresh Studio build this week that pushes its local fine-tuning UI well past train-and-chat into MCP-connected agent territory. The headline addition is built-in Model Context Protocol support: Studio now ships with Context7, Exa, and Hugging Face MCP servers enabled by default, lets a locally-served model such as Gemma 4 or Qwen3.6 call those tools autonomously inside one chat thread, and exposes a flow to add any custom MCP server by URL with OAuth or token auth and automatic tool discovery, per [Unsloth Documentation - How to Use MCP Servers with Local LLMs](https://unsloth.ai/docs/basics/mcp). The same build adds Data Recipes, a graph-based dataset workflow editor powered by NVIDIA Nemo Data Designer that ingests PDFs and CSVs, lets the user wire seed-data and generation blocks, preview sample output, and run a full synthetic-dataset build that feeds straight into a Studio fine-tune, per [Unsloth Documentation - Unsloth Data Recipes](https://unsloth.ai/docs/new/studio/data-recipe). Alongside the Projects, Canvas, and rebuilt chat-UI work, the release extends hardware coverage out to NVIDIA Blackwell and B300 on Linux and folds in Gemma 4 12B with a 256K-token context window as a runnable-and-trainable target on consumer-class memory — so the same tool used to QLoRA a small open model now doubles as a tool-using local agent client and a synthetic-data factory on hardware the developer already owns.

citations.label: Unsloth Documentation - How to Use MCP Servers with Local LLMs

technical.lead: Snowflake ships Iceberg v3 to GA with Polaris bi-directional writes
technical.body: The one artifact that actually reached general availability at Snowflake Summit 26's Builder Keynote (Wednesday June 3, 9:00 AM PT at Moscone) is Iceberg v3 with Polaris bi-directional writes, which lets external engines such as Spark and Trino write directly into Snowflake-managed tables through open standards with governance applied and no data duplication or downtime migration, with Affirm and Samsung Ads named as early adopters, per [Futurum - Snowflake Summit 2026: four infrastructure bets that determine whether the agentic enterprise delivers](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/snowflake-summit-2026-four-infrastructure-bets-that-determine-whether-the-agentic-enterprise-delivers/). The keynote anchored the story in live customer agents rather than slides: BlackRock demonstrated using Horizon Context so its agents operate on one shared definition of enterprise truth, and Sanofi showed an agent called Concierge that preps sales reps for physician visits off live data, the same week Sanofi named Snowflake as the backbone for its AI-powered drug-development work, per [BusinessWire - Sanofi Chooses Snowflake to Accelerate its AI-Powered Drug Development](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260602582503/en/Sanofi-Chooses-Snowflake-to-Accelerate-its-AI-Powered-Drug-Development).

technical.lead: Snowflake frames Cortex Sense ontology layer as the agentic-data stack
technical.body: Beyond the Iceberg v3 GA, three preview bets carry Snowflake Summit 26's agentic-enterprise pitch. Cortex Sense is a metadata-to-ontology layer that sits on top of the Horizon Context governance layer and auto-builds a shared skills-and-semantics surface that agents consume — Snowflake claims 3.5x better performance than Claude Code paired with MCP, a number it concedes is unproven in production. Alongside it, Snowflake Datastream is a fully managed Kafka-compatible streaming service that takes existing Kafka producers with zero code changes, and Adaptive Compute auto-sizes warehouses in real time to kill manual tuning, per [Futurum - Snowflake Summit 2026: four infrastructure bets that determine whether the agentic enterprise delivers](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/snowflake-summit-2026-four-infrastructure-bets-that-determine-whether-the-agentic-enterprise-delivers/). The throughline of the four bets is that the governed warehouse is being repositioned as the substrate agents reason over, not just the store they query.

technical.lead: Broadcom posts $10.8B AI-accelerator revenue, guides Q3 AI to ~$16B
technical.body: Broadcom reported fiscal Q2 2026 results after the close on June 3, and the AI-silicon line is the whole story. Consolidated revenue hit a record $22.2 billion, up 48% year over year, but the standout is AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8 billion, up 143%, driven by custom AI accelerators (Broadcom's XPUs) and AI networking, per [Grafa - Broadcom reports Q2 earnings: AI chip revenue jumps 143%](https://grafa.com/en/news/united-states/broadcom-q2-fy26-earnings-ai-growth). On the call, CEO Hock Tan guided Q3 AI semiconductor revenue to approximately $16 billion, over 200% year-over-year growth, and disclosed that bookings for AI semiconductors topped $30 billion in the quarter against the $10.8 billion shipped, while reiterating Broadcom's position supplying XPUs to its six core custom-silicon customers; total Q3 revenue is guided to about $29.4 billion, up 84%. Infrastructure software, the VMware-anchored segment, added $7.2 billion, up 9%. Free cash flow set a record at $10.3 billion and non-GAAP EPS came in at $2.44, and the stock rose about 2.6% in after-hours trading to roughly $494, per [Investing.com - Broadcom Q2 2026 earnings beat, stock rises (earnings-call transcript)](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/earnings-call-transcript-broadcom-q2-2026-earnings-beat-stock-rises-93CH-4674808). The read-through is that the custom-ASIC alternative to merchant GPUs is now compounding faster than the GPU incumbent's own growth rate, with a backlog that pre-commits multiples of current shipments.

technical.lead: Snowflake Summit and Microsoft Build close today; WWDC, Databricks ahead
technical.body: Today is the back half of the dense San Francisco conference window. Snowflake Summit 26 runs June 1-4 at Moscone Center, with the Builder Keynote of live agent demos this morning (Wednesday June 3, 9:00 AM PT) and the show floor open through Thursday, per [Moscone Center - Snowflake Summit 2026](https://www.moscone.com/events/snowflake-summit-2026). Microsoft Build 2026 reaches its final day today at Fort Mason Center (June 2-3), with the Wednesday program centered on live GitHub, Copilot, and Visual Studio agent sessions. AI Tinkerers SF still has an Advanced MCP Showcase sponsored by WorkOS and a Voice Agents Science Fair sponsored by ElevenLabs on its June calendar, per the [AI Tinkerers SF - events](https://sf.aitinkerers.org/) hub. Apple WWDC26 runs June 8-12 at Apple Park, with the keynote and Platforms State of the Union on Monday June 8 (keynote 10:00 AM PT), per [Apple Developer - WWDC26](https://developer.apple.com/wwdc26/). Databricks Data + AI Summit runs June 15-18 across Moscone with 800+ sessions spanning data engineering, governance, analytics, applications, and agents, per [Moscone Center - Databricks Data + AI Summit 2026](https://www.moscone.com/events/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026). The AI Engineer World's Fair runs at Moscone West with badge pickup Sunday June 28 (Day 0) and the main program June 29 through July 2 — 29 tracks, 300+ speakers, and 6,000+ AI engineers, founders, and VPs of AI, per the [AI Engineer World's Fair 2026](https://www.ai.engineer/worldsfair/2026) site.
